assessments.reasoning: Printed p. 95 gives DD * without DLM as the start of immediate in-stream data that ends at a default delimiter, a following // JCL record or exhausted input, subject to the APPC qualification. Printed p. 121 explicitly contrasts DD DATA.

challenge.method: Read the actual slash glyphs and the APPC note. Use DD DATA as the contrary case for //, and check DLM's separate JES2 and JES3 rules on p. 160. Trace both exact specimen payloads and their following comment and null records.
challenge.results: The no-DLM rules are directly stated. In APPC, the syntax is checked but the asterisk has no function. DD DATA can carry // records as input, and DLM has a separate termination rule. The copy controls and TSO/E input belong to their receiving programs.

limitations: The claim is confined to DD * without DLM outside APPC. It does not depend on the February p. 95 word count for a DLM delimiter or assert any embedded command syntax or operation.
